parse_glm47_tool_calls: parse GLM 4.7 model output text and extract structured tool calls with arg_key/arg_value tags
create_glm47_parser_instance: create a Glm47ToolCallParser instance via get_parser("glm47") from the parser registry
register_glm47_parser: register the Glm47ToolCallParser class under the name "glm47" using the @register_parser decorator
deserialize_glm47_args: deserialize GLM 4.7 arg values using json.loads, ast.literal_eval, and raw string fallback
list_registered_parsers: list all registered tool call parser names including "glm47" from the global parser registry
